newsitem.title: PERU: RESEARCH ALERT - Edegel started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Edegel started as buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Gilbert Casillas has started coverage of Peruvian power utility Edegel SA with a rating of buy.
-- "Commercial advantages lie in its two-tier capacity base: five baseline hydroelectric plants backed up with thermoelectric capacity," Casillas wrote in an April 11 report.
-- He assigned the buy rating based on "the company's market outlook and its attractive valuation."
-- The company's shares were up 0.03 sol to 1.23 soles in Lima.
